prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original fan-made production sprite sheet for a side-view tactical video game, faithful to Metal Gear Solid V The Phantom Pain (1984). EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 independently DRAWN full-body poses of ONE same character. Pure flat magenta #FF00FF canvas with five thin continuous pure cyan #00FFFF vertical grid lines and five horizontal grid lines, including outer boundaries. Each equal square cell must contain exactly one complete character, wholly inside, generous empty margin at least 30 pixels, no extremity or equipment on guides. Fixed camera, strict orthographic RIGHT-facing profile, feet bottom aligned, identical physical scale every frame. Detailed crisp military pixel art, clear small-scale silhouette, no scenery, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark. The sixteen poses must be genuinely different drawings, never simple shifted duplicates. Four phases per row in left-to-right time order, preserve all costume and identity features in EVERY pose. Keep weapons and hands compact inside their cell. Subject: Eli / young Liquid Snake in MGSV The Phantom Pain 1984. A small 12-year-old boy with child facial and body proportions, blond swept-back tousled mullet, frowning brows, pale skin. Faithful to Konami official TPP Eli portrait and Yoji Shinkawa model/concept: open olive green military jacket with frayed short sleeves, bare child chest with dark cord/beaded necklaces, camouflage military SHORTS rolled above knees, dark calf-height combat boots, black fingerless gloves, red beret attached over his shoulder rather than on his head. Compact holstered knife only, no gun. Functional nonsexual depiction of a child fighter, NOT muscular adult. Row1 four defiant idle breathing stages, arms down or compact fists. Row2 four compact right-facing walking gait stages with alternating feet positions heel/contact/pass/opposite contact. Row3 four stages of a firm tactical pointing gesture then lowering arm; keep nose to RIGHT. Row4 four phases of ducking/flinching and regaining defiant stance, no blood or death. All16 poses same open short-sleeve olive jacket and camo shorts, child proportions retained, no white expression marks or detached pixels.

references.kind: secondary mirror of attributed Konami/Shinkawa concept and game model

notes: Complete authored poses, right-facing readable identity and distinctive mobility/costume maintained.
Code Talker uses seated wheelchair motion; Huey uses both external leg braces; Eli retains child proportions as applicable.
Pixel-art adaptation and four-frame archive clips; not a claim of exact 1:1 likeness or complete combat implementation.
